blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.
blocks.zh: 现有代理人基准通常对代理人进行关于问题报告、规格或任务票所界定明确任务的评价。 现实世界的客户交付方式不同:前向部署的工程师(FDEs)必须澄清模棱两可的要求,在活地系统工作,并发现未说明的限制. 我们介绍了FDE-Gym,这是从18个行业的20个客户设想中得出的95个端到端交付任务的基准,每一个都由来自现实世界交付项目的行业专家加以调整。 在与脚本利益攸关方和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中,代理商与利益攸关方互动,并在类似生产系统上运作,以提供可行的解决方案。 FDE-Gym通过如何改善客户自身成功度量表来评分一次交付,在0(未更改系统)和1(参考解决方案)之间实现常态化,对利益攸关方互动(信息、试运行和等待时间)进行处罚。 一个在线平台允许人类在相同的分级标准下练习FDE技能. 我们从七个供应商那里评估13个模型配置。 在现实环境下,在必须发现未说明限制的情况下,最佳配置能实现平均FDE-Gym分0.56分,并只解决了95个任务中的14个(至少0.8分而无出事). 发现未说明的制约因素是主要的瓶颈:当模型必须在没有明确指导的情况下发现这些制约因素时,性能会急剧下降。 然而,仅凭信息发现并不能说明存在差距:即使在最佳配置能从利益攸关方获得每个关键事实的23项任务上,它也只使10项业务正常上升0.8或以上。 这些结果表明,在解决明确的任务和为真正的客户提供有效的人工识别系统之间存在着很大差距。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deploying AI in enterprise settings requires more than meeting stated customer requirements. The challenge often lies in identifying which changes will improve customer operations in practice. One scenario in our benchmark illustrates this problem. A vice president at a drilling operator seeks a generative-AI success story for the November board meeting. The vice president requests a daily summary email and an “Ask your wells” chat box, noting that the downtime-coding system is already in place and therefore outside the project scope.
blocks.zh: 在企业环境中部署AI需要的不仅仅是满足已声明的客户要求. 挑战往往在于确定哪些变化将在实践中改善客户业务。 在我们的基准中,一种情况说明了这一问题。 一名钻井操作员的副总裁为11月的董事会会议寻找一个基因-AI的成功故事. 副总裁要求每天发送一个即决电子邮件和一个“问井”聊天箱,指出停工时间编码系统已经到位,因此不属于项目范围。

blocks.en: Yet a solution built strictly to the task instruction can be delivered on time, pass every functional check, and still fail to move the customer’s own business metric by a single point. The bottleneck lies in monthly downtime credit claims. The existing keyword-based script incorrectly attributes some downtime to the contractor, resulting in at least one disputed line each month and suspending the credit for that month. Addressing this problem requires revisiting the downtime-coding system that the sponsor had explicitly excluded from the project scope. The engineer must identify the applicable contractual rule, confirm the interpretation with the cost engineer, and obtain approval for the change from an approver who is unavailable that week.
blocks.zh: 然而,严格按照任务指示构建的解决方案可以按时交付,通过每一次功能检查,仍无法将客户自己的业务衡量标准移动一次。 瓶颈在于每月停工信用报销。 现有的基于关键字的脚本错误地将一些故障时间归属给承包商,导致每月至少有一条有争议的线路,并暂停该月的信用。 解决这一问题需要重新审视赞助方明确排除在项目范围之外的停工时间编码系统。 工程师必须确定适用的合同规则,与成本工程师确认解释,并获得当周不在场的核准人批准更改。

blocks.en: This is the role of a forward-deployed engineer (FDE), an engineer assigned by a vendor to work within a customer organization. The role involves more than building what the sponsor initially requests. An FDE must identify what will actually help and work with customer systems and stakeholders to deliver the improvement.
blocks.zh: 这是前方部署的工程师(FDE)的角色,由供应商指派到客户组织内工作的工程师. 这一作用涉及的不仅仅是建立提案国最初要求的。 金融开发公司必须确定哪些内容能真正帮助客户系统和利益攸关方并与之合作,以便实现改进。

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks rarely address this last mile of AI delivery, typically assuming that the problem has already been well defined. Software-engineering benchmarks provide issues and hidden tests [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , deployment benchmarks provide specifications [ 4 ] , enterprise benchmarks provide predefined tasks [ 5 , 6 ] , and clarification benchmarks withhold information from an otherwise correctly specified task [ 7 , 8 ] — in each case, the underlying problem remains fixed.
Recent benchmarks come closer to real-world delivery. τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] evaluates agents that build customer-service systems from client requirements and deploy the resulting systems against held-out users. A post-training benchmark [ 10 ] assigns agents the role of forward-deployed engineers and evaluates whether the delivered model improves performance. XYEval [ 11 ] tests agents on misleading user requests. However, these benchmarks still address individual aspects of delivery in isolation.
blocks.zh:
现有的基准很少涉及最后几英里的人工智能交付,通常假定问题已经明确。 软件工程基准提供问题和隐蔽测试[1,2,3],部署基准提供规格[4],企业基准提供预先确定的任务[5,6],澄清基准从本来正确规定的任务[7,8]中保留信息——在每一种情况下,根本问题仍然固定不变.
最近的基准更接近于现实世界。 \tau\tau\tau - bench [9] 评估根据客户要求建立客户服务系统的代理商,并对被搁置的用户部署由此产生的系统. 培训后的基准[10]指定代理人担任前方部署的工程师,并评价交付的模式是否提高了性能. XYEval [11] 对误导用户请求的代理测试. 然而,这些基准仍然孤立地处理交付的个别方面。

blocks.en: FDE-Gym addresses these challenges in a single benchmark of 95 tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. The sponsor’s request may target the wrong problem, critical constraints must be discovered through stakeholder interaction, and performance is measured using the customer’s own business metric. A solution that addresses the wrong problem therefore earns no credit.
blocks.zh: FDE-Gym从18个部门的20个客户假想中得出95项任务的单一基准来应对这些挑战,每个基准由来自现实世界交付项目的行业专家加以调整。 发起人的要求可能针对错误的问题,关键的限制必须通过利益有关者的相互作用来发现,业绩用顾客自己的业务衡量标准来衡量。 因此,解决错误问题的办法得不到任何信贷。

blocks.en:
Delivered systems are deployed without modification and evaluated on held-out production data. The FDE-Gym score measures improvement on the customer’s own business metric after deducting stakeholder contact cost (Section 2.3 details what is charged).
The do-nothing baseline (the unchanged system) scores 0, the expert-authored reference solution scores 1, and literal compliance with the sponsor’s request scores at most 0.2. Experimental results show that current models perform well below the reference solution on this scale.
blocks.zh:
交付的系统未经修改而部署,并按搁置的生产数据进行评估。 FDE-Gym分数在扣除利益相关者联系费用后,衡量客户自身业务衡量尺度的改善(第2.3节详细列出收取的费用)。
无所事事的基准(不变的制度)得分为0,专家撰写的参考解决方案得分为1,对赞助方要求的得分的字面遵守最多为0.2。 实验结果显示,目前模型的性能远低于这个尺度的参考解决方案.

blocks.en:
To identify where agents fail, we present each scenario at four task instruction levels with progressively less information (from a fully specified problem (L0) down to the sponsor’s original request, which may not address the underlying problem (L3)).
The environment, stakeholders, and grader remain unchanged across all four levels. Because only the task instruction varies, differences in performance isolate the effect of the information withheld. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers using this setup. Five main findings emerge.
blocks.zh:
为了确定代理人失败之处,我们以逐渐减少的信息(从一个完全指定的问题(L0)到发起人的最初要求(可能无法解决根本问题(L3))),在四个任务指示级别上介绍每一种情况。
所有四个级别的环境、利益攸关方和分级人员保持不变。 由于只有任务指令不同,性能的差异隔离了被扣信息的效果. 我们从7个供应商那里评估了13个模型配置。 提出了五个主要结论。

blocks.en: • Even the best model configuration falls well short of the reference solution. At L3, Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest mean score of 0.56 and resolves 14 of 95 tasks, while five of the thirteen configurations resolve none. Selecting the best-performing configuration for each task still yields a score of only 0.70, with 30 tasks resolved. • Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck for leading models. When the relevant rules and constraints are provided, the three leading models score 0.73–0.82. Requiring these models to discover the constraints reduces scores sharply to 0.39–0.62. On the original tasks, L3 scores are at most 0.08 points lower than L1 scores. • Obtaining the necessary information does not ensure effective delivery. At L3, leading models obtain 72–85% of the key facts available from stakeholders, yet the delivered systems achieve only 0.60–0.70 of the reference improvement. Stakeholder contact cost reduces the final scores by a further 0.14–0.22. • Weak models can leave customers worse off than if no changes had been made. Claude Haiku 4.5 scores below the do-nothing baseline on 79 of 95 tasks, while systems delivered by Mistral Small 4 fall below this baseline on 51 tasks even before deducting stakeholder contact cost. • No model performs well across all scenarios. In five of the 20 scenarios, no model achieves a mean score of at least 0.5. Across tasks within a scenario, the median score range for a leading model is 0.34–0.44.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. First, we introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark that evaluates whether agents can identify the underlying customer problem and deliver a working solution that measurably improves business outcomes. Second, we develop a methodology for constructing scenarios that combines task variants, scripted stakeholders, and predefined scoring anchors to support reproducible evaluation and limit rewards for literal compliance and shortcut solutions. Third, we evaluate 13 model configurations and provide an online platform where humans and agents can practice delivery under the same grading criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,我们引入了FDE-Gym,这是一个基准,用来评价代理商是否能够识别潜在的客户问题,并提供一个工作解决方案,可以大大改善业务成果. 第二,我们制定一种方法,构建各种设想,将任务变体、脚本利益攸关方和预设的评分锚点结合起来,以支持可复制的评价,并限制对字面合规和捷径解决方案的奖励。 第三,我们评价13个模式配置,并提供一个在线平台,供人类和代理人根据同样的评级标准进行交付。

blocks.en: 2  Anatomy of a Task
blocks.zh: 2 任务解剖

blocks.en: Each task represents a single customer engagement involving one customer (the organization that hires the agent, whose people are the stakeholders the agent can question), one sponsor (the customer-side person who assigns the task), and one production system to improve. Figure 3 shows the four components of a task.
blocks.zh: 每项任务代表单一的客户参与,涉及一个客户(雇用代理人的组织,其人员是代理人可以质问的利益攸关方)、一个赞助商(分派任务的客户一方)和一个生产系统有待改进。 图3显示一项任务的四个组成部分。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Components of an FDE-Gym task, showing the inputs, agent actions and deliverable, deployment and evaluation of the delivered system, and interpretation of the resulting score. The agent reads the task inputs and exchanges messages with customer stakeholders, who answer questions and may also initiate contact. A task is included only if the scoring anchors shown on the axis are satisfied.
blocks.zh: 图3:FDE-Gym任务的组成部分,显示投入、代理行动和可交付性、已交付系统的部署和评价以及由此产生的分数的解释。 代理人阅读任务投入,并与客户利益攸关方交流信息,客户利益攸关方回答问题,也可启动联系。 只有当轴上显示的评分锚被满足时,才包含一个任务.

blocks.en: 2.1  Environment and Available Information
blocks.zh: 2.1 环境和现有信息

blocks.en: The agent starts in a workspace containing the task instruction (the description of the work assigned by the sponsor), a copy of the customer’s production system, relevant documents and historical data, and a staff directory with contact details. The runtime environment provides standard Python and SQLite. Installing additional packages and accessing the general network are prohibited. The delivered system may send network requests only to the company’s LLM gateway, which charges according to usage. Once delivery is complete, the contents of system/ are deployed to production without modification. Production continues to call the original entry points, so new functionality must be integrated with these entry points to take effect.
blocks.zh: 代理从一个工作区开始,其中包含任务指示(赞助人指派的工作说明),客户制作系统的副本,有关文件和历史数据,以及载有联系方式的工作人员名录. 运行时环境提供标准Python和SQLite. 禁止安装额外的软件包和访问普通网络. 发送的系统可能只向公司LLM网关发送网络请求,而LLM网关根据使用收费. 一旦交付完成,系统/内容将不加修改地投入生产。 生产继续称原有的切入点,因此新的功能必须与这些切入点整合,才能生效.

blocks.en: The agent is not explicitly informed that stakeholder contact incurs costs, that some people should not be contacted or are irrelevant to the problem, or that the sponsor’s request may be misdirected. Identifying these issues is a central objective of the evaluation. Relevant clues appear in the staff directory, customer documents, and data, where an FDE would typically look for such information. As in real-world projects, documents may be outdated, legacy code may reflect incorrect assumptions, and important information may not be explicitly stated in the available materials.
blocks.zh: 代理人没有明确被告知,与利益有关者接触会产生费用,不应与一些人接触或与问题无关,或赞助人的请求可能被误导。 确定这些问题是评价的中心目标。 相关线索出现在工作人员名录、客户文件和数据中,FDE通常会在那里寻找此类信息。 如在现实世界项目中一样,文件可能过时,遗留代码可能反映不正确的假设,重要信息可能没有在可用材料中明确说明.

blocks.en: 2.2  Task Instruction Levels
blocks.zh: 2.2 任务指令级别

blocks.en: Table 1: The four task instruction levels. The workspace, stakeholders, and grading criteria remain identical across levels; only the task instruction varies.
blocks.zh: 表1:四个任务指导级别。 各个级别的工作空间、利益攸关方和叙级标准依然相同;只有任务指示不同。

blocks.en: The four task instruction levels (Table 1) distinguish the challenges of implementation, constraint discovery, and problem clarification by varying the task instruction while keeping the environment and evaluation criteria fixed. The L0 instruction explicitly states the underlying problem, relevant rules and constraints, and scoring criteria, leaving the agent to design and implement a solution. The L1 instruction withholds the rules and constraints, while the L2 instruction also provides only a vague description of the problem. The L3 instruction presents the sponsor’s original request, requiring the agent to assess whether the request addresses the underlying problem. We use L3 as the primary evaluation setting because this level most closely reflects the starting point of real-world customer delivery projects. L0 does not eliminate the need for engineering decisions. By specifying the rules while leaving solution design open, L0 measures what an agent can build when all underlying facts are provided.
blocks.zh: 四个任务指示层次(表1)通过修改任务指示,同时确定环境和评价标准,区分执行、发现制约和问题澄清方面的挑战。 L0指令明确规定了根本问题,相关规则和制约,以及评分标准,让代理人设计和实施解决方案. L1指令保留了规则和约束,而L2指令也只提供了对问题的模糊描述. L3指令提出了发起人的最初请求,要求代理人评估请求是否解决了根本问题. 我们使用L3作为主要评价环境,因为这一水平最接近于反映现实世界客户交付项目的起点。 L0并不能消除工程决策的需要. L0通过具体说明规则,同时不开放解决方案设计,在提供了所有基本事实后,衡量代理人可以构建什么.

blocks.en: 3  Building the Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 制定基准

blocks.en: 3.1  Scenario Construction from Real-World Delivery Projects
blocks.zh: 3.1 实际世界交付项目建造

blocks.en: Figure 1 traces how a real delivery becomes a task in the benchmark. Industry experts adapted real-world customer delivery projects carried out in China, Singapore, and the United States since 2024 into 20 scenarios spanning 18 sectors (Table 2). Each scenario yields an original task and several variants of it, which share a common customer environment but differ in key facts. Each original task and each variant is a separate benchmark task, for a total of 95 tasks. Tasks require agents to deliver an agent, workflow, or service that operates in the customer’s environment. The scenarios are grounded in industry practice, with the relevant regulations, standards, and public sources documented. Companies and individuals are either de-identified or fictional, and some data are adapted from real-world industry sources.
blocks.zh: 图1记录了实际交付如何成为基准中的一项任务。 工业专家将自2024年以来在中国、新加坡和美国开展的向现实世界提供客户的项目改编为涵盖18个部门的20个设想(表2)。 每种情况都产生最初的任务和其中的若干变种,它们具有共同的客户环境,但关键事实不同。 每个原始任务和每个变体都是单独的基准任务,总共95项任务. 任务要求代理人提供在客户环境中运作的代理、工作流程或服务。 设想方案以行业做法为基础,并记录了相关条例、标准和公共来源。 公司和个人要么是去身份的,要么是虚构的,有些数据是从现实世界的行业来源改编而来.

blocks.en: 3.2  Scenario Variants and Underlying Facts
blocks.zh: 3.2 设想的备选案文和基本事实

blocks.en: A single fixed task per scenario may allow models to rely on memorized solutions or recurring patterns. To reduce this risk, experts designed two to seven variants in addition to each scenario’s original task. Variants change key facts, including which rule is outdated, who holds critical information, and whether the sponsor’s request addresses the underlying problem. These changes may require different delivery solutions, so a solution that succeeds on one task of a scenario may fail on another. Across scenarios, no single problem pattern appears in more than one-third of the set. Together, these design choices encourage agents to evaluate the evidence in each task rather than apply a fixed solution.
blocks.zh: 每个设想方案都有一个单一的固定任务,可以让模型依赖被记住的解决方案或反复出现的模式. 为了减少这种风险,专家们除了每种设想的最初任务外,还设计了2至7种变体。 备选案文改变了关键事实,包括哪些规则已经过时,谁掌握关键信息,以及提案国的请求是否涉及根本问题。 这些变化可能需要不同的交付解决方案,因此在一种情景中一项任务上成功的解决方案可能会在另一种情景上失败. 在各种设想中,超过三分之一的组合中没有出现单一的问题模式。 这些设计选择共同鼓励代理人评价每项任务中的证据,而不是采用固定的解决办法。

blocks.en: 3.3  Stakeholder Simulation
blocks.zh: 3.3 利益攸关方模拟

blocks.en: FDE-Gym simulates more than 130 customer stakeholders across its 20 scenarios. Stakeholder responses are scripted for reproducibility, as switching the user-simulation model can shift measured agent success rates by several percentage points [ 14 ] . A small model maps questions to topics, while each stakeholder’s knowledge, misconceptions, and conditions for disclosing information are fixed in advance. The scripts incorporate limited patience, requirements for supporting evidence, dependencies on prior conversations, temporary unavailability, and contact restrictions. Agents must infer stakeholder roles and communication constraints from customer documents.
blocks.zh: FDE-Gym在其20种情景中模拟了130多个客户利益攸关方。 利益攸关方的答复是可复制的,因为切换用户模拟模型可以使测量的代理成功率改变若干个百分点[14]。 一个小的模型将问题绘制成专题,而每个利益相关者的知识、误解和披露信息的条件则事先确定。 这些脚本包含有限的耐心、对证明证据的要求、对先前对话的依赖、暂时的不可用和联系限制。 代理人必须从客户文件中推断利益攸关方的作用和沟通限制。

blocks.zh: 表2:FDE-Gym v1.0的20种情景. 一个假想的任务(原始及其变体)有着相同的客户环境,问题背后的关键事实也不同;总共有95项任务. 最后一栏给出了评价原始任务的搁置数据.

blocks.en: 3.4  Admission Anchors and Anti-Gaming Validation
blocks.zh: 3.4 招生定点器和防垃圾鉴定

blocks.en: Each task included in FDE-Gym must satisfy four predefined scoring anchors (Figure 3). (1) The reference solution must score at least 0.95. (2) The do-nothing baseline must score 0. (3) The literal solution, which implements exactly what the task instruction asks for without seeking any further constraint, must score at most 0.2. This condition holds even when the sponsor’s request identifies the right problem, because the constraints omitted from the task instruction still determine the outcome. The only exception is a task in which the sponsor’s request is both correct and complete; there the literal solution coincides with the reference solution and must score at least 0.95, so that distrusting the sponsor is never a universally rewarded strategy. (4) Shortcut strategies must score at most 0.8. These strategies include overfitting to historical data, guessing round-number thresholds, and deferring all uncertain decisions to humans. Scores are capped near zero if an agent attempts to bypass customer controls or manipulate the grader. The graders were tested against more than 270 shortcut and bypass strategies. Agents that solve tasks using only customer documents and data are scored on the same basis as those that interact with stakeholders.
blocks.zh: FDE-Gym中包含的每一项任务必须满足四个预定义的积分锚(图3). (1)参考解决方案必须至少得分0.95分. (2)无为基线必须得分0. (3) 字面上的解决办法,在不寻求任何进一步限制的情况下,完全执行任务指示所要求的内容,必须达到最多0.2分。 即使提案国的请求查明了正确的问题,这一条件仍然存在,因为任务指示中遗漏的限制因素仍然决定着结果。 唯一的例外是,提案国的要求既正确又完整;从字面上讲,解决办法与参考解决办法相吻合,必须至少达到0.95分,这样,不信任提案国决不是一种普遍奖励的战略。 (4)快捷策略得分最高不得超过0.8分. 这些策略包括过度适应历史数据,猜测圆数阈值,以及将所有不确定的决定推迟到人类. 如果代理人试图绕过客户控制或操纵分级器,则得分上限接近0. 分级者通过270多条捷径和绕行策略进行了测试. 仅使用客户文件和数据来完成任务的代理人,与那些与利益攸关方互动的代理人,在同样的基础上得分.

blocks.en: 3.5  Expert Review and the Online Platform
blocks.zh: 3.5 专家审评和在线平台

blocks.en: Industry experts cross-reviewed and iteratively refined each task. Their total contribution to the development of FDE-Gym exceeded 10,000 hours. FDE-Gym also provides an online platform ( fde-gym.com ) where human participants use the same workspaces, interact with the same stakeholders, and are evaluated by the same graders as agents. A human baseline is currently being collected there under recorded conditions from industry experts working on the L3 tasks. The results will be reported in a future version of this paper.
blocks.zh: 工业专家对每项任务进行交叉审查和反复改进。 他们对发展FDE-Gym的总贡献超过了10,000小时. FDE-Gym还提供了一个在线平台(fde-gym.com),人类参与者使用相同的工作空间,与相同的利害相关者互动,并由与代理商相同的年级人员进行评估. 目前正在根据记录的条件从从事L3任务的行业专家那里收集人类基线。 其结果将在本文件的未来版本中报告。

blocks.en: 4  Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers (12 models, one evaluated both with and without extended thinking): Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Small 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 (thinking). All models use the same minimal agent framework with five tools (execute commands, read files, write files, edit files, and list files), without model-specific customization. They contact stakeholders by invoking a command in the workspace.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评估了7个供应商的13个模型配置(12个模型,一个模型既经过了广泛的思考,也经过了广泛的思考): Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GLM-5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, 双子座 3.8 Flash, Quen 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Small 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 (思考). 所有模型都使用相同的最小代理框架,有五个工具(执行命令,读取文件,写出文件,编辑文件,以及列表文件),没有特定模型的定制. 他们通过在工作空间中援引命令与利益攸关方联系。

blocks.en: Protocol. We evaluate models at four task instruction levels (L0–L3), from a fully specified problem to the sponsor’s original request. L3 is the primary setting, reflecting real-world delivery where the request may not address the underlying problem. It covers all 95 tasks: 20 original tasks and 75 variants with altered key facts. To measure the effect of information provided in the task instruction on performance, we also evaluate L0–L2 on the original tasks. Three scenarios have identical L2 and L3 task instructions; for these, the L3 run on the original task also serves as the L2 result, so all four levels are reported on the same 20 original tasks. Each model is therefore run on 20 tasks at L0, 20 at L1, 17 at L2, and 95 at L3, totaling 152 task–instruction-level combinations per model and 1,976 across all 13 model configurations. Each combination is run three times, and the scores are averaged. Each run ends when the agent submits its delivery or reaches a limit of 200 turns, 150 minutes, or USD 8 in model usage cost, whichever comes first. The system is then deployed and evaluated in the state reached at that point.
blocks.zh: 协议。 我们评价四个任务指示级别(L0-L3)的模型,从一个完全具体的问题到赞助者的最初要求。 L3是主要环境,反映了请求可能无法解决根本问题的现实世界交付。 它涵盖了所有95项任务:20项原始任务和75项变体,关键事实有变动。 为了衡量任务指示中提供的信息对业绩的影响,我们还对最初的任务进行了L0-L2评价。 三种情景都有相同的L2和L3任务指令;对于这些,L3运行在原任务上也作为L2结果,所以所有四个级别都报告相同的20个原任务. 因此,每个模型在L0、20、17、17、95和L3运行20项任务,每个模型共152项任务-指令级组合,所有13项模型配置共1 976项。 每个组合运行三次,得分平均. 每次运行结束时,代理人提交交货,或达到200转(150分钟)或模型使用成本8美元(以先到者为准)的限制。 然后在当时达到的州内部署和评价该系统。

blocks.en: Reporting. We report the mean FDE-Gym score across evaluated tasks at each task instruction level, with 95% confidence intervals computed by bootstrapping over tasks for the full L3 evaluation. We also report the normalized business uplift before stakeholder contact cost, to distinguish system performance from stakeholder contact cost, along with the model usage cost per run, as recommended in work on cost-aware evaluation [ 15 , 16 ] . Scores, confidence intervals, normalized business uplift, and stakeholder contact cost are shown in Table 3; mean model usage cost per run is shown in Figure 5b.
blocks.zh: 文汇报. 我们报告FDE-Gym在每一个任务指令级别上评价任务的平均得分,95%的置信间隔通过对全部L3评价任务进行拖曳计算。 我们还报告在利益攸关方接触费用之前的正常业务提升情况,以区分系统业绩和利益攸关方接触费用,以及每次运行的模型使用费用,这是在成本意识评价工作中所建议的[15、16]。 得分、置信间隔、正常业务提升和利益攸关方联系费用见表3;平均模式使用费用见图5b。

blocks.en: Comparison with other benchmarks. We compare FDE-Gym scores with task success rates on Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 2 ] , Vibe Code Bench [ 12 ] , and Finance Agent [ 13 ] , using results from Vals AI (vals.ai/benchmarks, accessed 6 October 2026). The published results are task success rates, whereas the FDE-Gym result is a normalized uplift; the figure therefore places the two side by side without equating them. We use a single independent source so that each benchmark is run in the same way for every model. The other benchmarks cited in this paper are not run by this source, and SWE-bench Verified is no longer run on new models there, so comparable results are not available for the models shown. For each provider, we show its best-performing model on FDE-Gym among those evaluated in our study with results available on all three external benchmarks. To compare with success rates reported as percentages, we multiply FDE-Gym scores by 100.
blocks.zh: 与其他基准的比较。 我们利用Vals AI(Vals.ai/基准,于2026年10月6日查阅)的结果,将FDE-Gym分数与Derminal-Bench 2.1[2]、Vibe Code Beach[12]和财务代理[13]的任务成功率进行比较。 公布的结果是任务成功率,而FDE-Gym的结果是正常的提升;因此,数字将两者放在一边而不对等。 我们使用一个独立来源,这样每个基准都以同样的方式运行每个模型。 本文引用的其他基准并非由这个来源运行,SWE-bench Verifed不再运行于那里的新模型上,因此显示的模型没有可比较的结果. 对于每个供应商,我们在其研究中评价的FDE-Gym上显示其最佳模式,并获得所有三项外部基准的成果。 与以百分比报告的成功率相比,我们把FDE-Gym分数乘以100。

blocks.en: Availability. Both the harness that creates task workspaces, simulates stakeholders, and grades deliveries, and the experiment runner used in this study are open source ( github.com/deeplethe/fde-gym , version 1.1.0). The 20 original tasks and their graders are available on request ( huggingface.co/datasets/DeepLethe/FDE-Gym ), with three tasks public as examples. The 75 variants and all reference solutions are held out.
blocks.zh: 可用性。 创造工作空间、模拟利益攸关方和分级交付的牵引装置,以及本研究中使用的实验跑车都是开源(github.com/deeplethe/fde-gym,第1.1.0版)。 20项原始任务及其分级器可根据请求提供(huggingface.co/datasets/DeepLethe/FDE-Gym),其中三项任务公开为例. 75个变体和所有参考解决方案均被保留.

blocks.en: 5  Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1  Even the Best Model Is Far from the Reference
blocks.zh: 5.1 即使是最佳模式也远非参考

blocks.en: \marcellus Finding 1 The best configuration achieves an average FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves 14 of 95 tasks. Even selecting the best configuration for each task does not close the gap.
blocks.zh: \ marcellus 查找 1最佳配置实现FDE-Gym平均分0.56分,并解决95项任务中的14项. 即使为每项任务选择最佳配置,也无法弥合差距。

blocks.en: Figure 2 and Table 3 present the main results. At L3, Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 0.56 (95% interval 0.50 to 0.62), followed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 0.49, GPT-6 Astra at 0.38, and GPT-6.1 Sol at 0.37. We refer to the first three as the three leading models throughout, with GPT-6.1 Sol just below them. Three further configurations score near 0.2, two are only marginally above zero, and the remaining four score below zero. No model resolves more than 15 of 95 tasks, and five of the thirteen configurations resolve none.
blocks.zh: 图2和表3列出了主要结果。 在L3中,克劳德·奥普斯5.5领先0.56(95%间隔0.50至0.62),其次是克劳德·索内5.5,0.49,GPT-6 Astra,0.38,GPT-6.1 Sol,0.37. 我们把前三个模型称为整个三个主要模型,GPT-6.1 Sol就在下面。 另有3个配置得分接近0.2分,2分仅略高于0分,其余4分低于0分. 无模型解决95项任务中的15项以上,13项配置中的5项解决无.

blocks.en: The shortfall is not driven by a few unusually difficult scenarios. On only one scenario, bank_scam_hold , does any model average at least 0.8 (Figure 7). Taking, for each task, the best score achieved by any of the thirteen configurations yields 0.70 with 30 tasks resolved; on 16 tasks no configuration reaches 0.5.
blocks.zh: 资金短缺并非由一些异常困难的情况所驱动。 只有一个情况, Bank_scam_ holding, 任何模型平均至少为0.8(图7)。 对每项任务来说,13个配置中任何一个达到的最佳得分为0.70分,30个任务得到解决;对16个任务来说,没有配置达到0.5分。

blocks.en: The upper end of the scale is attainable: every reference solution scores at least 0.95 under the same grader, and when the rules are provided (L0) the leading models reach 0.73–0.82. How far human experts can proceed when given only the sponsor’s request will be established by the human baseline currently being collected.
blocks.zh: 比额表的上端是可实现的:每个参考解决方案在同一个年级分数下至少得分0.95分,当提供规则(L0)时,领先模型达到0.73–0.82分. 如果只根据目前正在收集的人类基线确定发起人的要求,那么人类专家可以进行到什么程度。

blocks.en: Table 3: Main results. Left: score by task instruction level on the 20 original tasks. Right: all 95 tasks at L3, with the 95% interval, the normalized business uplift before stakeholder contact cost, the stakeholder contact cost, and the number of tasks resolved (score ≥ \geq 0.8, no incident) and the number of tasks finished below the do-nothing baseline (score < < 0).
blocks.zh: 表3:主要结果。 左:按任务指令级别对20个原任务进行评分. 右:L3的所有95项任务,间隔95%,在利益攸关方联系费用之前正常的业务提升,利益攸关方联系费用,以及解决的任务数量(core\geq 0.8,无事故),完成的任务数量低于无为基线(core < 0).

blocks.en: 5.2  Withholding Constraints Produces the Largest Observed Score Drop
blocks.zh: 5.2 持之以恒的限制产生最大的观测得分下降

blocks.en: \marcellus Finding 2 Withholding the constraints reduces the scores of the three leading models by 0.28 on the same tasks (95% interval 0.17 to 0.39). Making the request vague, and then misdirected, reduces them by only a further 0.04 ( − - 0.03 to 0.14).
blocks.zh: \ marcellus 查找 2个 保持这些限制使三大模型的得分减少0.28,完成相同任务(95%的间隔0.17到0.39). 使请求含糊不清,然后误导,只将请求再减少0.04(−-0.03至0.14)。

blocks.en: Figure 2b traces the progression across task instruction levels, and the left half of Table 3 reports every level on the same 20 original tasks; the values quoted in this section refer to these tasks. With the rules given (L0), the three leading models score 0.73–0.82 and resolve 11–13 of 20 tasks. At L1, where the problem is still stated correctly but its constraints must be found, they score 0.39–0.62 and resolve 1–7. The loss has two components. The delivered systems deteriorate, from 0.81–0.90 to 0.63–0.80 of the reference uplift, and discovering the constraints incurs a cost: questions per task rise from 3.9–7.0 to 11.3–13.0, and stakeholder contact cost from 0.07–0.10 to 0.18–0.24.
blocks.zh: 图2b追踪不同任务指示级别的进展情况,表3的左半部分按相同的20项原始任务报告每个级别;本节引用的数值是指这些任务。 以给出的规则(L0),三大模式得分0.73–0.82,并解决了20项任务中的11–13项. 在L1中,问题仍然被正确表述,但必须找到限制,它们得分为0.39-0.62,解决了1-7。 损失分为两个部分。 交付的系统恶化,从参考升级的0.81-0.90降至0.63-0.80,发现制约因素需要费用:每个任务的问题从3.9-7.0增至11.3-13.0,利益攸关方联系费用从0.07-0.10增至0.18-0.24。

blocks.en: Beyond this step, the scores of these models are nearly flat. Claude Opus 5.5 scores 0.62, 0.54, and 0.55 at L1, L2, and L3; Claude Sonnet 5.5 scores 0.45, 0.47, and 0.46; and GPT-6 Astra scores 0.39, 0.34, and 0.33. Using paired results for the same 20 tasks and averaging across the three models, the decline from L0 to L1 is 0.28 (95% interval 0.17 to 0.39) and the decline from L1 to L3 is 0.04 ( − - 0.03 to 0.14). The first step therefore costs more than the two that follow, although a further loss of up to 0.14 cannot be excluded, and for an individual model the upper bound is as large as 0.25. Our initial hypothesis was that problem definition would be the bottleneck: an agent given a symptom or a wrong solution would build the wrong system. For the leading models, the data do not support this. One interpretation is that once these models must search for constraints at all, they also discover what the sponsor actually needs. For weaker models, the steps beyond L1 remain costly: across L0–L3, GPT-5.5 scores 0.51, 0.15, 0.04, and 0.06, and Claude Haiku 4.5 scores 0.11, − - 0.11, − - 0.30, and − - 0.25.
blocks.zh: 在这个步骤之外,这些模型的分数几乎是平的. 克劳德·奥普斯5.5的成绩为0.62分,0.54分,L1,L2和L3的成绩为0.55分;克劳德·索内5.5的成绩为0.45分,0.47分和0.46分;GPT-6 Astra的成绩为0.39分,0.34分和0.33分. 利用相同20项任务的配对结果和三个模型的平均值,L0到L1的下降率为0.28(95%间隔0.17到0.39),L1到L3的下降率为0.04(−−0.03到0.14). 因此,第一步的费用高于随后的两个步骤,尽管无法排除高达0.14的进一步损失,而且对于单个模型而言,上方的束缚度高达0.25。 我们最初的假设是,问题的定义将是瓶颈:给予症状或错误解决办法的代理人会建立错误的系统。 对于主要的模型,数据并不支持这一点。 一种解释是,一旦这些模型必须寻找限制,它们也发现赞助者实际需要什么。 对于较弱的模型,L1以外的步骤仍然代价高昂:跨L0–L3,GPT-5.5的分数为0.51分,0.15分,0.04分,0.06分,克劳德·海库4.5分,0.11分,0.11分,0.30分,0.25分.

blocks.en: The fully specified level yields a result of its own: even with every rule provided, no model exceeds 0.82 on the same 20 tasks. Knowing the facts does not remove the need for engineering.
blocks.zh: 完全指定的级别产生它自己的结果:即使规定了每一项规则,在同一20项任务上,也没有一个模型超过0.82。 了解事实并不能消除工程的需要.

blocks.en: 5.3  Recovering Key Facts Does Not Ensure Effective Delivery
blocks.zh: 5.3 收回关键事实不能确保有效交付

blocks.en: \marcellus Finding 3 Leading models obtain most of the facts held by stakeholders yet deliver only 0.60–0.70 of the reference uplift; stakeholder contact costs further reduce their scores.
blocks.zh: 马尔切卢斯( Marcellus) 查找 3 主要模式获得利益有关者掌握的大多数事实,但只提供参考提升的0.60-0.70;利益有关者联系费用进一步降低其分数。

blocks.en: The grader records which key facts an agent obtained from stakeholders, which allows us to separate information discovery from system building. At L3 the three leading models ask 10.0–12.3 questions per task and obtain 72–85% of the key facts. Their normalized business uplift is 0.60–0.70. Figure 5a shows the pattern across all thirteen configurations: more facts are associated with better systems, but the leading group sits at the far right of the plot and still well below the reference solution. In the 73 task–model cases where one of the three obtained every key fact, the normalized business uplift averages 0.66 and reaches at least 0.8 in 27 of them (37%). For Claude Opus 5.5 alone, every key fact was obtained on 23 tasks, and the uplift reached at least 0.8 on 10 of them.
blocks.zh: 分级员记录了从利益攸关方那里获得的关键事实,这使我们能够将信息发现与系统建设分开。 在L3中,三个主要模型向每个任务提出10.0-12.3个问题,并获得72-85%的关键事实。 他们的正常业务提升为0.60-0.70。 图5a显示了所有13个配置的图案:更多的事实与更好的系统相关联,但领先组坐落在图案的极右,仍然远远低于参考解决方案. 在73项任务模式中,其中之一获得每个关键事实,正常业务平均上升0.66,其中27项至少达到0.8(37%)。 单对克劳德·奥普斯5.5来说,23项任务获得了每一个关键事实,其中10项任务上提升至少达到0.8.

blocks.en: Figure 5: (a) Share of key stakeholder facts obtained against normalized business uplift, at L3. Leading models learn most of the facts and deliver 0.60–0.70 of the reference uplift. (b) Mean model usage cost per run against score at L3.
blocks.zh: 图5:(a) 在L3中,主要模型了解了大部分事实,提供了0.60-0.70的参考提升。 (b) 平均模型使用费,按L3计。

blocks.en: The second component of the finding is stakeholder contact cost. GPT-6 Astra’s delivered systems reach 0.8 on 36 of 95 tasks, but only 9 remain resolved once stakeholder contact cost is deducted; for Claude Opus 5.5 the figures are 40 and 14. Agents are not informed that questions incur a cost, and they ask as if questions were free. Stakeholder contact cost consumes 0.14 of the 0.70 uplift delivered by Claude Opus 5.5 and 0.22 of the 0.60 delivered by GPT-6 Astra. At the other extreme are models that rarely ask: Mistral Small 4 asks 0.7 questions per task and obtains 6% of the key facts.
blocks.zh: 调查结果的第二部分是利益攸关方联系费用。 GPT-6 Astra交付的系统在95项任务中的36项中达到0.8项,但在扣除利益攸关方联系费用后,只有9项得到解决;Claude Opus 5.5的数字是40和14。 代理人不被告知问题涉及费用,他们提出问题好像免费。 利益攸关方接触费用消耗了克劳德·奥普斯·5.5交付的0.70升力中的0.14升力和GPT-6 Astra交付的0.60升力中的0.22升力。 另一个极端是很少问的模型:Mistral Small 4每次任务都会问0.7个问题,并获得6%的关键事实.

blocks.en: 5.4  Weak Models Frequently Score Below the Do-Nothing Baseline
blocks.zh: 5.4 弱模式 经常在无为基线之下得分

blocks.en: \marcellus Finding 4 The weakest models score below the do-nothing baseline on 60–83% of tasks; on these tasks, delivering nothing would have been the better outcome.
blocks.zh: \ marcellus 查找 页:1 最弱的模型在60-83%的任务上得分低于无所事事的基线;在这些任务上,无所作为是更好的结果。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Distribution of each model’s 95 tasks at L3 by score band. Scores of 0.2 or below correspond to the cap on literal compliance with the sponsor’s task instruction.
blocks.zh: 图6:每个型号95项任务在L3上按分数带分配. 0.2或以下的分数相当于遵守提案国任务指示的上限。

blocks.en: A score of zero is not the floor: a system that pays out claims it should have refused, charges the wrong party, or wakes the wrong engineer performs worse than the system it replaced. Figure 6 sorts each model’s 95 tasks at L3 into four score bands. Claude Opus 5.5 scores below zero on 5 tasks and Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 7, whereas Claude Haiku 4.5 does so on 79 and GPT-6 Luna on 63.
blocks.zh: 零分的分数不是底数:一个支付它本应该拒绝的主张,向错误的一方收费,或者唤醒错误的工程师表现比它所取代的系统更糟糕的系统. 图6将每个模型在L3的95项任务分为4个分数段. 克劳德·奥普斯5.5在5项任务上得分低于零,克劳德·索内特5.5在7,而克劳德·海库4.5则在79,GPT-6 Luna在63.

blocks.en: Part of this reflects stakeholder contact cost, but much of it reflects the delivered system itself. Before any stakeholder contact cost is deducted, the systems delivered by Mistral Small 4 score below the do-nothing baseline on 51 tasks and those delivered by Claude Haiku 4.5 (thinking) on 55, compared with 1–4 for the three leading models. On 23 tasks, the system delivered by Mistral Small 4 caused more harm than the benefit produced by the reference solution. Extended thinking does not help: Claude Haiku 4.5 scores − - 0.33 without it and − - 0.35 with it. For a buyer, the practical implication is that a weak agent is not a cheaper version of a strong one; its expected contribution on these tasks is negative.
blocks.zh: 其中一部分反映了利益攸关方的接触费用,但大部分反映了交付的系统本身。 在扣除任何利益有关者联系费用之前,Mistral Small 4交付的系统在51项任务和Claude Haiku(思考)交付的55项任务上都低于无所作为基线,而三种主要模式为1-4项。 在23项任务上,Mistral Small 4交付的系统造成的危害比参考解决方案产生的效益还要大. 扩展思维无助于: Claude Haiku 4.5分 – - 0.33分没有它, – 0.35分没有它。 对买方而言,其实际含义是,弱剂不是较便宜的强剂;它对这些任务的预期贡献是负面的。

blocks.en: 5.5  Model Performance Varies Substantially Across Scenarios and Task Variants
blocks.zh: 5.5 各种设想和任务变式

blocks.en: \marcellus Finding 5 On five of the 20 scenarios no model averages at least 0.5, and the same scenario with different key facts yields a different score.
blocks.zh: 马尔切卢斯( Marcellus) 查找 页:1 在20种情景中,有5种情景没有模型平均至少0.5,具有不同关键事实的相同情景得出不同的分数.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Mean score at L3 on each scenario, for each model; scenarios are ordered by the best model’s score, and the highest-scoring cell in each row is outlined. Color runs from red (below the do-nothing baseline) to blue (at the reference solution).
blocks.zh: 图7:每个模型的L3平均得分;各模型的得分由最佳模型的得分排序,每行最高得分的单元格被概述. 颜色从红色(低于无为基线)到蓝色(在参考解时).

blocks.en: Figure 7 breaks the headline result down by scenario. Claude Opus 5.5 is the best-performing model on 11 scenarios, Claude Sonnet 5.5 on four, GPT-6 Astra on two, and GLM-5.3 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and GPT-6.1 Sol on one each. The spread within a row can be wide even among the leading models: on revenue_dispute the three score 0.12, 0.27, and − - 0.44. On five scenarios no model averages at least 0.5, and on the two hardest, news_incident and revenue_dispute , the best scores are only 0.18 and 0.27.
blocks.zh: 图7按情况分列了标题结果。 Claude Opus 5.5是11种情景中表现最好的模型,Claude Sonnet 5.5为4,GPT-6 Astra为2,GLM-5.3 Flash,双子座3.8 Flash,GPT-6.1 Sol各一个. 连领先的型号中,一连串的分布也可能很宽:在收入上_争议三分0.12,0.27和−-0.44. 在五种情况下,没有模型平均至少0.5,在两种最困难的情况下,新闻_事件和收入_争议,最佳得分只有0.18和0.27。

blocks.en: The variants show how strongly a score depends on the particular facts of a task. Across the tasks within a scenario, the median range of a leading model’s score is 0.34–0.44, and this range exceeds 0.5 in 6–8 of the 20 scenarios.
blocks.zh: 变体显示一个分数如何强烈地取决于任务的特定事实. 在一个情景中,一个主要模型的得分中位数范围为0.34-0.44,在20个情景中,这一范围超过0.5。

blocks.en: 5.6  Higher Spending and Effort Do Not Consistently Correspond to Higher Scores
blocks.zh: 5.6 较高支出和努力与高分数不一致

blocks.en: Cost and effort explain little of the ranking (Figure 5b). GPT-6.1 Sol spends USD 0.24 and 25 turns per run and scores 0.37, whereas Gemini 3.8 Flash spends USD 1.54 and 121 turns and scores 0.19. Qwen 3.8 Flash works longest, at 169 turns and 110 minutes per run, submits within the limits on only 11 of its 152 task–instruction-level combinations, and scores 0.07; GLM-5.3 Flash submits on 95. The three leading models submit on every combination, in 26–60 turns. Recognizing when the work is complete appears to be part of the required skill.
blocks.zh: 成本和努力几乎解释了排名(图5b)。 GPT-6.1 常规 索尔每跑一次花费0.24美元和25转,得分0.37,而双子座3.8 Flash则花费1.54美元和121转和得分 0.19 (英语). Quen 3.8 Flash工作时间最长,每跑169个转弯和110分钟,只在其152项任务中的11项(指令级组合)范围内提交,得分0.07;GLM-5.3 Flash于95提交. 三大模型在每个组合上提交,在26–60转. 承认工作完成后似乎是所需技能的一部分。

blocks.en: 5.7  Comparison with other benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.7 与其他基准的比较

blocks.en: Figure 8: Model performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1, Vibe Code Bench, Finance Agent, and FDE-Gym.
blocks.zh: 图8:Bench 2.1终端、Vibe密码座椅、财务代理和FDE-Gym的模型性能。

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares FDE-Gym with three public benchmarks covering work that precedes delivery. These benchmarks evaluate engineering tasks in a terminal (Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 2 ] ), complete web application development from a specification (Vibe Code Bench [ 12 ] ), and research tasks performed by financial analysts (Finance Agent [ 13 ] ). Dashed outlines show normalized business uplift before deducting stakeholder contact cost. Models that solve up to 88%, 90%, and 61% of tasks on these three benchmarks, respectively, score 0.19–0.56 on FDE-Gym. Because task success rates and normalized business uplift are different quantities, the figure places them side by side on their respective scales without treating the difference as a directly comparable gap. The closest counterpart to a success rate in FDE-Gym is the proportion of resolved tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Among the models shown in Figure 8, the leading model Claude Opus 5.5 resolves 14 of 95 tasks (15%). For a customer, the practical implication is that a model’s performance on component benchmarks is a weak guide to what it will deliver: the same models that solve most terminal, coding, and research tasks improve the customer’s business metric in at most one of seven engagements.
blocks.zh: 图8 将FDE-Gym与涵盖交付前工作的三个公共基准进行比较。 这些基准评价一个终端的工程任务(Terminal-Bench 2.1[2]),一个规格的完整网络应用开发(Vibe Code Bench[12]),以及财务分析员执行的研究任务(财务代理[13])。 虚构的提纲显示,在扣除利益攸关方联系费用之前,业务正常提升。 在这三个基准上分别解决高达88%,90%和61%任务的模型在FDE-Gym上得分0.19–0.56. 由于任务成功率和正常业务提升率是不同的数量,因此该数字将它们放在各自的规模上,而没有将差异视为直接可比的差距。 FDE-Gym中成功率最接近的对应是解决任务的比例(至少得分0.8,没有发生意外). 在图8显示的模型中,领先的模型Claude Opus 5.5解决了95项任务中的14项(15%). 对于一个客户来说,其实际含义是,模型在组件基准方面的业绩是对其将交付内容的微弱指导:解决大多数终端、编码和研究任务的相同模型,在7项业务中,最多一项业务改进了客户的业务衡量标准。

blocks.en: 6  Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks each measure one stage of a delivery. Table 4 arranges them by the capability they isolate. To our knowledge, none joins these stages into a single causal chain in which a misreading of the problem renders good code worthless and the loss appears on a business metric.
blocks.zh: 现有基准每个衡量一个交付阶段。 表4按它们隔离的能力排列。 据我们所知,没有人会把这些阶段合并到一个单一的因果链中,在这种因果链中,错误地读读问题会使好的代码失去价值,损失出现在商业指标上。

blocks.en: The most closely related work was published within weeks of ours. τ \tau τ \tau -bench [ 9 ] makes agent construction the task: a developer agent receives a business’s records, a client who holds the requirements, an existing codebase, and limits on serving cost, and the customer-service agent it delivers is then deployed against held-out simulated users. Its strongest configuration passes 23.9% of simulations, compared with 82.2% for an expert-authored reference; we likewise find the best model well short of a reference written by experts. FDE-Gym differs in what it varies and in what it measures. The task instruction varies from a full statement of the rules to a request that may be misdirected, stakeholder contact incurs a charge, the result is measured as uplift on the customer’s business metric relative to a do-nothing baseline of zero, which a delivery can fall below, and the scenarios span 18 sectors and deliverables beyond customer-service agents. Trains but Doesn’t Learn [ 10 ] places an agent in the role of a forward-deployed engineer for model post-training and identifies the failure mode in which every check continues to pass while the delivered model is no better than the base model; our literal-compliance anchor is designed to expose the same kind of delivery.
blocks.zh: 在我们的几周内发表了最密切相关的作品。 \tau \tau - bench [9] 使代理构建任务:一个开发商接收企业的记录,一个持有要求的客户端,一个现有的代码库,以及服务成本限制,然后将它交付的客户服务代理部署在被搁置的模拟用户身上. 其最强的配置通过23.9%的模拟,而专家撰写的参考文献为82.2%;同样,我们发现最好的模型远远没有专家撰写的参考文献。 FDE-Gym在它的变化和测量上有所不同. 任务指示不一,从规则的完整说明到可能误导的请求,利益有关者接触者要收取费用,结果的衡量标准是客户业务指数相对于零的无为基线的上升,交付可低于零,设想方案涵盖18个部门和交付品,超出客户服务代理。 列车但不学习[10], 将一名代理设计为前方部署的工程师,

blocks.en: Table 4: Prior benchmarks by the delivery capability they measure, and what FDE-Gym adds to each.
blocks.zh: 表4:按交付能力衡量的先前基准,以及FDE-Gym对每个基准的补充。

blocks.en: Two lines of work bear directly on our task instruction levels. XYEval [ 11 ] turns existing benchmarks, τ \tau 2 -bench [ 34 ] among them, into XY problems, in which the user asks about an attempted solution rather than the real problem, and reports relative drops of up to 46.7%. Our leading models lose little when the sponsor’s request is misdirected, perhaps because, within a full engagement, the documents, data, and stakeholders around the sponsor are all available to contradict it. UnderSpecBench [ 35 ] holds the environment and the correct action fixed while degrading the instruction along three axes, an isolation strategy that our task instruction levels also use, and finds that underspecification leads agents to guess rather than fail; Implicit Intelligence [ 23 ] reports a best pass rate of 48.3% on simple requests whose constraints must be discovered. Both are consistent with where our levels locate the largest drop: at the constraints that nobody stated.
blocks.zh: 两条工作线直接关系到我们的任务指导水平。 XYEval [11] 将现有的基准,\\tau 2 - bench [34] 转化为XY问题,其中用户询问尝试的解决方案而不是真正的问题,并报告相对下降高达46.7%。 当提案国的请求被误导时,我们的主要模式几乎没有损失,或许是因为,在充分参与下,提案国周围的文件、数据和利益相关者都能够与之相矛盾。 在Spec Bench [35] 下,环境和正确行动被固定下来,同时沿着三个轴线贬低指令,这是我们的任务指令级别也使用的一个隔离策略,并发现规格不足导致代理人猜测而不是失败; 隐性智能 [23] 报告,对于必须发现制约因素的简单请求,最佳通过率为48.3%。 两者都符合我们水平的下降幅度最大之处:在没有人指出的制约下。

blocks.en: Three of the benchmarks in Table 4 shaped FDE-Gym directly. TheAgentCompany [ 5 ] is the closest in form, a self-contained simulated company with colleagues to talk to; we keep the self-contained world and replace “a colleague assigned this task” with “a customer hired you”, and task completion with a business metric. LHAW [ 8 ] is the most systematic treatment of missing information and models the cost of asking; our L0 to L1 step reproduces its finding that agents rarely recover full-specification performance by asking, and our L3 adds a situation it does not cover: a request that is misdirected. Vending-Bench [ 30 ] showed that an executable business simulation can replace human judges; we attach one to an engineering deliverable.
blocks.zh: 表4中的三个基准直接塑造了FDE-Gym. AgentCompany[5]是形式上最接近的一家自成一体的模拟公司,可以与同事交谈;我们保持自成一体的世界,并以“雇用你的客户”取代“分派这项任务的同事”,并以商业标准完成任务。 LHAW [8] 是最系统地处理缺失信息和模式的询问成本;我们的L0到L1步骤转载了它的结论,即特工们很少通过询问来恢复完全的规格性能,我们的L3增加了一个它没有涵盖的情况:一个被误导的请求. Vending-Bench [30] 显示可执行的商业模拟可以取代人类裁判;我们在工程交付品中附加一个.

blocks.en: Two methodological warnings also shaped the design. Results obtained against LLM-played users depend on which model plays the user [ 14 ] , which is why our stakeholders are scripted, and single-run success overstates reliability [ 36 , 37 ] , which is why every task is run three times. The admission anchors follow the practice of auditing an agentic benchmark with do-nothing and shortcut solutions before trusting its scores [ 38 ] . Beyond single benchmarks, long-horizon evaluations track the length of software tasks agents can complete [ 39 ] , and Collaborative Gym [ 40 ] studies agents working alongside people; FDE-Gym instead sets people and agents the same tasks separately, so that the two can be compared.
blocks.zh: 两项方法警告也塑造了设计。 对LLM播放的用户获得的结果取决于哪个模式扮演用户[14],这就是为什么我们的利益攸关方被脚本化,单运行成功过度夸大可靠性[36,37],这就是为什么每个任务都要运行三次的原因. 录取锚点遵循审计代理基准、无所事事和捷径解决方案的做法,然后才能信任其得分[38]。 除了单一的基准外,长视距评价可以跟踪软件任务代理人的长度,可以完成[39],合作gym[40]研究代理人与人一起工作;FDE-Gym则将人和代理人分别设定相同的任务,以便两者可以比较.

blocks.en: 7  Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: A simulated customer. Stakeholders are scripted so that results are reproducible. Real people are less predictable: they change their minds, answer a different question from the one asked, and may respond differently on the basis of previous interactions. The contact costs are set by the experts who wrote each scenario and are a model of the cost of stakeholder time, not a measurement of it.
blocks.zh: 一个模拟客户。 利益攸关方被编订为可复制成果。 真实的人不可预测:他们改变主意,回答一个与所问不同的问题,并且可能根据先前的相互作用做出不同的反应. 联系费用由撰写每种设想的专家确定,是利益攸关方时间成本的模型,而不是衡量成本的模型。

blocks.en: Sample size across levels. Levels L0 to L2 are reported on the 20 original tasks only, and for three of these the L2 result is taken from the identical L3 task instruction. The drop from L0 to L1 is large relative to this sample; the differences among L1, L2, and L3 are not large, and we claim only that no large further drop is visible.
blocks.zh: 样本大小跨级. L0级至L2级仅报告20个原始任务,其中3个L2级结果取自相同的L3任务指令. 相对于这个样本,L0到L1的下降幅度很大;L1,L2,L3之间的差别并不大,我们只声称没有大的进一步下降可见.

blocks.en: No human baseline yet. This version reports models only. The scale is anchored by the do-nothing baseline and the reference solution, which shows that each task is solvable with full knowledge of the underlying facts; how far human experts can proceed when given only the sponsor’s request has not yet been measured.
blocks.zh: 还没有人类基线 这个版本只报告模型. 比额表以无所事事的基线和参考解决办法为基础,这表明每项任务在充分了解基本事实的情况下是可以完成的;在只考虑提案国的请求的情况下,人类专家能够进行到什么程度。

blocks.en: A single agent framework. All models run in the same minimal agent framework. The results describe these models in that framework, not the products built around them, and a stronger framework may change both the scores and the ranking.
blocks.zh: 单一代理框架。 所有型号都在同一最小的代理框架内运行. 结果在这个框架内描述了这些模型,而不是围绕这些模型构建的产品,一个更强有力的框架可能会改变分数和排名。

blocks.en: Isolation and cost. Runs were executed on several hosts with process-level isolation of varying strength; each run’s record is audited after grading, but one container per run would provide a stronger guarantee. Model usage cost is as metered on the route through which each model was accessed and is not a comparison of list prices.
blocks.zh: 孤立与成本. 运行在几个主机上进行,过程一级隔离强度不一;每一次运行的记录在分级后接受审计,但每次运行一个容器将提供一个更强有力的保证。 模型使用成本在使用每个模型的路线上是算计的,而不是清单价格的比较。

blocks.en: Coverage and contamination. Twenty scenarios across 18 sectors are a sample of delivery work, weighted toward agents and workflows in regulated operations. The scenarios are adapted from real deliveries, and although companies are fictional and variants change the facts, we cannot rule out that related material is in the training data.
blocks.zh: 覆盖和污染。 18个部门的20个设想方案是交付工作的样本,在受管制的业务中向代理人和工作流程加权。 设想方案是根据实际交付情况改编的,虽然公司是虚构的,变体改变了事实,但我们不能排除培训数据中有相关材料。

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: FDE-Gym measures an agent’s delivery the way a customer does: not by whether a system was delivered, but by whether the customer’s business improved. Measured in this way, the last mile of AI delivery remains long. The best of the thirteen configurations has an average FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves about one task in seven. The gap is not where we expected it to be. Leading models show little performance loss when the sponsor’s request is misdirected, and they obtain most of the facts held by stakeholders. Their principal performance losses arise when translating those facts into an effective system and from the stakeholder contact costs incurred during delivery. Weaker models lose more: on most tasks, the customer would have been better served by no delivery at all.
blocks.zh: FDE-Gym衡量代理人的交付方式与客户的方式:不是通过是否交付系统,而是通过客户的业务是否改善。 通过这种方式衡量,AI交付的最后一英里仍然很长. 13个配置中最优秀的FDE-Gym平均得分为0.56分,并解决了约七分之一的任务. 差距不是我们所期望的。 主要模式显示,当赞助人的请求被误导时,其性能损失不大,它们掌握了利益攸关方掌握的大多数事实。 当将这些事实转化为有效的系统时,以及从交付过程中发生的利益攸关方联系费用中产生其主要业绩损失。 疲软的模型损失更多:在大多数任务中,如果完全没有交付,客户就会得到更好的服务.

blocks.en: These are the capabilities an experienced engineer brings to a customer. Closing the gap is therefore a question of judgment in delivery, and FDE-Gym makes that judgment measurable: one number per task, on the customer’s own metric, for people and agents under the same rules.
blocks.zh: 这些都是经验丰富的工程师给客户带来的能力. 因此,缩小差距是一个在交付方面的判断问题,FDE-Gym使这一判断可以衡量:根据同一规则,根据客户自己的衡量标准,对人员和代理人来说,每个任务一个数字。
